load_f0_extractor_pyaapt: create a pYAPT F0 extractor instance using load_f0_extractor with method pyaapt
load_f0_extractor_fcpe: create an FCPE F0 extractor instance using load_f0_extractor with method fcpe and a device
run_pYAAPT_forward: run the pYAAPTF0Extractor forward pass on an audio file path to extract fundamental frequency
run_FCPE_forward: run the FCPEF0Extractor forward pass on a numpy waveform to extract fundamental frequency and voicing
review_F0Extractor_base: review the F0Extractor base class forward method and load_audio for audio loading and resampling
